source_revision: immutable archive bytes identified by SHA256

selection.strategy: complete timestamp-group blocks; greedy feature coverage then temporal quantiles
selection.ordering: UTC nanoseconds, member name lexicographically, one-based source line
selection.normalization: canonical fields only; absent -> null; no forward fill; invalid timestamps excluded
selection.bias: purposive balanced sample of first1000-batch verified subset; not representative of complete corpus
selection.nonoverlap: strict timestamp separation within each machine
